identity.name: LLaMA-2-vicuna-7b-slerp
identity.summary: LLaMA-2-vicuna-7b-slerp is a merge of lmsys/vicuna-7b-v1.5 and togethercomputer/LLaMA-2-7B-32K created with LazyMergekit.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only merge recipe and architecture; no training data, evaluation, or development details for this exact checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Merge of two open-weight models with no stated provenance or verification of the underlying training data lineage.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not define intended use or deployment context for this text-to-text merged model.

specifications.model_size: 12.6 GiB of safetensors weights (13,476,864,936 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This checkpoint is a merge of LLaMA-2-vicuna-7b-slerp and other models, created using LazyMergekit with the slerp merge method.
